'''Maggie McDowell''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
McDowell became a voice actress, with her first role being on {{aniseries|PTS}}. She voiced [[Miette]], {{an|Serena}}'s [[rival]] in [[Pokémon Showcase]]s, during {{aniseries|XY}}. She also voiced some minor roles in ''[[XY111|Unlocking Some Respect!]]'' and ''[[XY112|Master Class Is in Session!]]''.
